behavioral_signatures: Brute-force attacks on RDP and SSH services
Credential harvesting and privilege escalation post-breach
Lateral movement using legitimate admin tools (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Mimikatz, AnyDesk)
Network scanning for PoS software and sensitive data
Deployment of ransomware or wiper malware after privilege escalation
file_indicators: Unusual remote admin tool installations (e.g., AnyDesk on servers)
Unexpected scripts or binaries in PoS or critical infrastructure directories
network_indicators: Unusual outbound connections to known C2 infrastructure
High volume of SSH (port 22) and RDP (port 3389) login attempts
Connections to dark web or cryptocurrency payment addresses
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for brute-force attempts on SSH and RDP ports, especially port 22, and alert on repeated failed logins. Detect lateral movement by tracking the use of admin tools like Cobalt Strike, Mimikatz, and AnyDesk, especially if they appear on endpoints where they are not expected. Watch for network scanning activity targeting PoS systems and sensitive infrastructure. Use behavioral analytics to identify privilege escalation and credential harvesting. Monitor for ransomware or wiper malware deployment patterns, including mass file encryption or deletion, and unexpected outbound data transfers.
